facts.note: Transcript gives the nine o'clock temple bell, the watch-showing, Félix's watch at twenty minutes to nine, and the scolding by Aurèle.
Piquet in the salon without a break, temple striking ten during play, play continuing until he went out for cigars, and she did not look at the clock when he went.

The sheet says he asked her to play as he went out. The interviewer asks 'Before he went out, did he say anything,' and she answers 'He asked me to play for him' without correcting the timing, so the sequence shifts from simultaneous to before. The piano playing until he came back and stopping when he came in are otherwise exact.
'Then a moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven.'
